slice_contract.real_problem: determine whether current fixed-Pro production trajectories contain a measured environment-command, setup, service or UI-runtime verification loss that a deterministic ProjectEnvironmentProfile can independently fix
acceptance: derive the profile from deterministic project and tool facts
bind every admitted runtime artifact to the latest workspace revision
activate service or UI collection only from a typed TaskContract requirement
reduce environment setup failure or guessed commands
preserve root and isolated Writer parity
add no second environment store, platform, browser mode or tool owner
delete any replaced duplicate detection after caller migration
slice_contract.cutover_on_no_delta: create no production profile or runtime artifact branch and retain the existing exact verifier and execution-fingerprint owners

current_owner_graph.current_behavior: RunEnvironment persists canonical workspace, provider, tool catalog, execution fingerprint, write mode and sandbox controls; resume recomputes and rejects catalog or fingerprint mismatch before HTTP
ProductionToolExecutionIdentity freezes workspace, authority, shell and sandbox policy, external-path trust and non-secret policy digests
production resolves caller parameters to one exact VerifierSpec before RunCreated and requires the same resolver result on resume
the advisory auto profile deterministically recognizes Rust, Node, Python and Go manifests and commands; Host acceptance rejects mutable auto plans and requires exact commands
verification captures revision before and after execution, emits an inline hash-checked ToolArtifact only when stable, and the Host seals the matching EvidenceReceipt

current_owner_graph.owner: retained TUI doctor and tool-specific production configuration
current_owner_graph.current_behavior: the TUI doctor probes Python, Pandoc, pdftotext, rustc and gh for user diagnostics; it is not a canonical AgentRuntime project-profile caller and cannot become a second environment truth

raw.observer_note: one frozen false-success label is the already documented evaluator false positive, not an environment failure

raw.quality_note: the frozen quality veto is a child-call argument mismatch, not an environment failure

missing_trigger_fact.consequence: a global profile or browser/service collector would have no canonical task-scoped caller and would need to guess from task text, manifests or generic operation_failed

offline_conformance: run_verifiers auto plan recognizes all supported ecosystems
exact resolver injects the same deterministic environment used at execution
successful Python verification leaves the workspace clean
failed Python verification leaves no ignored cache
production start replaces a caller-authored verifier plan with the canonical exact plan
production resolves and seals the exact latest-revision Host receipt
catalog or execution-fingerprint mismatch fails before any HTTP request
Writer uses one Runtime with fresh worktree tools and root post-merge evidence

decision_rule.reason: current production data contains no environment/setup/runtime-artifact loss and no typed TaskContract trigger; the existing exact verifier already owns deterministic build/test command execution and revision-bound evidence
decision_rule.forbidden_result: do not duplicate run_verifiers ecosystem detection, persist a second project profile, enable a global browser/service mode, or interpret generic operation_failed as an environment cause

non_conclusions: does not claim that service or UI tasks never need runtime artifacts
does not claim that current tool-version identity covers every future reproducibility need
does not admit static verification as a substitute for runtime behavior when a future typed TaskContract requires runtime evidence
does not delete the TUI doctor or tool-specific dependency diagnostics
does not change fixed actor routing, exact verifier completion authority or billing_unknown fail-closed behavior
